/api/mapping/whammy-dt.name: Whammy DT

identity.note: DIN muette : pas de SysEx Identity, pas de VID:PID — le modèle est déclaré. ⚠ Whammy IV / Whammy 5 / DT n'ont PAS la même table de PC : la révision fait le mapping.

/api/mapping/whammy-dt._source: 100% CALIBRÉ MATÉRIEL (2026-07-07, 3 passes) : fil 0-based ; colonne WHAMMY = ordre du manuel p.6 (montées d'abord) : ↑2Oct ↑1Oct ↑5th ↑4th ↓2nd ↓4th ↓5th ↓1Oct ↓2Oct Dive, Detune DEEP(10)/SHALLOW(11) ; HARMONY 12-20 = manuel p.7 inversé (bas->haut), noms format face (grave↓ aigu↑). Les 39 modes validés à l'oreille.
/api/mapping/whammy-dt.bypass_rule: Pas de PC 0 global : bypass = PC bypass DE l'effet (whammy/harmony = actif+21 ; drop/raise = actif+18). Valeurs FIL 0-based.
/api/mapping/whammy-dt.pitch_rule: Whammy/Harmony/Detune = sweep par le treadle (CC11, 0=talon/haut, 127=pointe/bas). Drop/Raise Tune = accordage FIXE, PAS de treadle.

needs: Volt 276 MIDI OUT → Whammy DT MIDI IN

steps.title: Cable
steps.do: Plug the Volt 276 MIDI OUT into the Whammy DT MIDI IN.
steps.hint: The pedal never answers on MIDI — the wire only goes one way.

steps.title: MIDI channel
steps.do: The Whammy DT listens on channel 1 out of the box. golem sends on channel 1.
steps.hint: If you changed it on the pedal, set the same number in this mapping.

steps.title: Kill the merge on the FCB1010
steps.do: If your FCB1010 sits on the same chain, its MIDI MERGE must be OFF.
steps.hint: Merge ON loops golem's own Whammy messages back in — page 3 of the FCB global setup.

checks.label: 1 Octave Up
checks.expect: toe down = one octave above the played note

checks.label: Bypass
checks.expect: the pedal is out of the way — dry signal only

checks.label: Treadle sweeps
checks.expect: the pitch glides while the sweep runs

provenance.note: 100 % calibré matériel (2026-07-07, 3 passes) — les 39 modes validés à l'oreille ; table de PC recoupée avec le manuel p.6/p.7.
